name: cwi_needle_drop_verify
description: Verify a claimed playlist placement against the honest Needle Drop ledger (CWI A&R). The ledger ships empty and only gains entries after full-scan verification — a curator's promise is a claim, never a verification. Reads needle-drop.json + its schema, and the verified placements section of catalog.json (3 tracks verified holding on 'New Rap Hits', full-scan verified 2026-09-15).

playlist_name.description: Playlist the placement is claimed on.

claim_source.description: Where the claim came from (e.g. 'curator message', 'submission receipt').
